items.title: Itaberá (SP) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #8
items.en_title: Itaberá (SP) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #8
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Itaberá (SP) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 190,644; proposals close Nov 24, 16:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
